pgw_log_level.description: Log verbosity level. Use DEBUG for troubleshooting.

pgw_log_file.description: Path to PGW log file, or 'stdout' to log to console.

pgw_identity_fqdn.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) of the PGW used in Diameter messages.

pgw_identity_realm.description: Diameter realm of the PGW (typically same as MNC/MCC domain).

pgw_mme_peers.description: List of MME/SGW peers for S5/S8 connectivity (e.g., in multi-MME deployments).

pgw_apn_list.description: List of supported APNs, each defining QoS, UE address pool, DNS, and MTU.

pgw_charging_gx_enabled.description: Enable Gx interface to PCRF for policy and charging control.

pgw_charging_gx_destination_realm.description: Diameter realm of the PCRF (required if Gx enabled).

pgw_charging_gy_enabled.description: Enable Gy interface to AAAR for online charging (e.g., for prepaid subscribers).

pgw_charging_gy_destination_realm.description: Diameter realm of the AAAR (required if Gy enabled).

pgw_limits_max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent PDN connections (sessions) the PGW can handle.

pgw_limits_max_bearers_per_ue.description: Maximum number of bearer connections allowed per UE (standard: 11, includes default bearer).

pgw_limits_gtpu_echo_interval.description: Interval (seconds) for GTP-U echo requests; set to 0 to disable echo.
